meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: one tool plus two injections. see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel); memory index injection (the store root holds machine-shared entries, machines/<machine>/ holds machine-private ones); workflow discipline injection (discipline.md is read on every request and the template path is rendered into templates.md; requirement → approach sign-off → plan → review → plan challenge → go-ahead → build → falsification gate → commit → delete the plan).
